explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/376: EGRS75 proved that for any two odd primes p and q there are infinitely many n with C(2n,n) coprime to pq. The statement asserts this for odd primes p, q. The degenerate case p = q (coprime to p², i.e. to p) is also true, by Kummer's theorem with base-p digits < p/2. Faithful.
